svg.title: The bend: the 2020 Magna quake (M5.7), drawn two ways
svg.desc: The M5.7 Magna quake of 2020 recorded by 31 University of Utah stations out to 397 km, drawn twice. Left, plain time (0 to 60 s): the first P arrivals (30 picks, 17 of them computer picks) follow a 6.2 km/s line near the quake and a faster 7.8 km/s line farther out; the lines cross at 149 km. Right, the same records in reduced time, t minus d/8: the 7.8 km/s arrivals run almost straight down and the 6.2 km/s ones lean to the right, so the bend is easy to see. Extended back to 0 km, the faster line starts at 6.2 s (the intercept time).
svg.text: The bend: the 2020 Magna quake (M5.7), drawn two ways
